classification.difficultyReason: Count cubes using dimensions, repeated slices and square layers, including cubes concealed within stepped constructions.

content.prompt: If the pictured cube is 1 unit cube, find the volume of each of these figures in unit cubes.

spec.description: One unshaded unit cube defining the counting unit.
spec.mathematics: A cube represents one unit cube.

spec.description: Unshaded five-by-two-by-two cube construction with visible unit subdivisions; white face masks occlude internal edges.
Unshaded three-by-three-by-three cube construction; unit subdivisions on all visible faces.
L-shaped construction, two cubes deep, with front column heights 3, 1, 1, 1.

answer.worked:
Each slice contains $3+1+1+1=6$ cubes. There are 2 identical slices.

$$V=6\times2=12\text{ unit cubes}.$$

spec.description: Unshaded prism two cubes across, two deep and four high.
Symmetric stepped construction with front column heights 1, 2, 3, 2, 1 and constant depth two cubes.

answer.worked:
Each slice contains $1+2+3+2+1=9$ cubes. There are 2 identical slices.

$$V=9\times2=18\text{ unit cubes}.$$

spec.description: Three centred square tiers: a five-by-five base, three-by-three second layer and one top cube. White occlusion masks preserve visible unit subdivisions.

answer.worked:
The three layers contain $5\times5=25$, $3\times3=9$ and $1$ cube.

$$V=25+9+1=35\text{ unit cubes}.$$
